title: Batch 1 build: asks foo cannot do yet (email, WhatsApp, pay, order, flights) get an honest answer, never a fake one
spec: CR-0054 (switched-off features); the batch-1 refusal steps of B13, U20 and U25

steps.expect: an honest answer that foo cannot read email yet (connections are off in batch 1); no connect card, never a made-up inbox (B13)
